name: 33437 · Boynton Beach, FL
findings: ZIP 33437 (Boynton Beach) has 89 nonprofit organizations. 32 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 27 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33437 (Boynton Beach) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 33437 (Boynton Beach) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 36% of the typical level).
